steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've had to fight through so many Reunion just to reach this observation point...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that... Madam Ch'en?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Why are there so many bodies...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (So many fallen Reunion troops... did Madam Ch'en do all this by herself?!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I lost control of myself. Sorry...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I might have fallen into the enemy's trap...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No... It's fine, we're still on track with the original plan. It's just that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The one who appeared earlier... was that Talulah?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...No. It doesn't matter now. My gut feeling was wrong. This place doesn't look like some place that person would be anyway.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Our mission still remains top priority.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Without me, the L.G.D. would struggle to carry out this search mission.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Especially given this current situation...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's a lot more complicated than I expected.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: With things as they are, it's far too risky to push further alone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, we also hope that you can return to the L.G.D. right away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The large amounts of Originium residue left here by the Catastrophe is very harmful to the uninfected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if you brought medication beforehand, it won't last long...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our mission is to protect Lungmen and eliminate threats--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the most important reason for us coming here is to rescue our operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island does not turn its back on anyone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Therefore, we will continue to carry out our combat operations.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll bring my squad to merge with yours... if the situation allows for it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's great.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en! Rhodes Island can dispatch a squad to escort you...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Madam Ch'en has a lot of pride, huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm? Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know... Rhodes Island will be fighting alone again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, it's too early to be feeling down.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Come on, Jessica and the others are still waiting for us.
